name: Eeyyon
description: Eeyyon was the Mid Rim planet saved by the Jedi prior to the Clone Wars. It was inhabited by a species of tall, pale-skinned humanoids. Native of Eeyyon, Teluron Thacker swore to aid the Jedi Order wherever he was, in gratitude for the help given to his homeworld.
lead_paragraphs: Eeyyon was the Mid Rim planet saved by the Jedi prior to the Clone Wars. It was inhabited by a species of tall, pale-skinned humanoids. Native of Eeyyon, Teluron Thacker swore to aid the Jedi Order wherever he was, in gratitude for the help given to his homeworld.
